scope: Archived profiler-disabled stable service histograms; each delta includes 10 warmup + 300 formal requests. Three rounds provide n=930 server samples and n=900 formal client samples.

definitions.queue: Native engine QUEUED to first SCHEDULED event interval
definitions.running_inference: Native first SCHEDULED to last engine output event; includes model/decision-head execution and required waits, rather than a sum of kernels
definitions.prefill: Native first SCHEDULED to first output event; pooling performs a single output step
definitions.e2e: Native request arrival to finished request statistics; API work before EngineClient.encode is outside this scope
definitions.native_remainder: Same-population native e2e minus queue minus running contains frontend/IPC/postprocessing timing gaps
definitions.client_http: Benchmark urlopen through complete response-body read; JSON decode and protocol validation are separate
definitions.comparison: Client 900 and server 930 populations differ. Their mean difference mixes timing scope and warmup effects; matched-request telemetry is required for a frontend-only latency estimate.
